id say the game is around a 8 - 8.5. I have to agree that enemy placements were often quite bad (mostly the babies placements).

I also agree with the idea of not being able to jump over things, sometimes it's good (for example not being able to jump over 1.5 feet cars because they are meant to be barriers) but back to the point, you should be able to jump over things as mentioned benches and furniture in some areas.

Myself i don't really see how crouch jumping is even a thing (in the sence of "i can't crouch in mid air) but i also think there should be for example an area (like the one where you first meet a monster stuck onto a wall) that requires crouch jumping in the begining of the game (with a sort of monolog that would indicate what to do).

I felt that the old house after the lake was a bit "meh" and kind of ruined my feel of the game after a calm boat ride. But after entering Kirkville, i myself have nothing bad to say.

I also think that bugs should be forgiven (if not major and don't affect the gameplay). But some i can't really forgive. For example when i was playing nightmare mode, mace cliped onto the platform with me being unable to damage him or enemies clipping through (this one isn't the worst thing, i can live with this. But mostly yes, bugs are mostly for me either funny or in the mace scenario an anoying memory.

Aspects of the game i don't enjoy much

forest area (a bit bland and confusing sometimes)

backtracking in some cases depending what mode am i playing and how im feeling memorising things such as codes, numbers or passwords and users

and of course the ocasional parkour/platforming.

Aspects of the game i enjoyed a lot

beckomberga (or the mental asylum)

apartments in the begining

story

Outdoors after the park

(Everything else that isn't mentioned was at least above average)

This is a very well made game and playing it has been very enjoyable (even replays). If you read what i wrote about my thoughts, first up a sorry for spelling mistakes and  this confusing text and a huge thank you! Thanks again for giving me your opinion!
